syllabus_topics: Basic topological notions in R^n, sequences
Extrema and saddle points of scalar fields
Applications of inverse and implicit function theorems
Applications of curves, paths, and line integrals
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus for line integrals and applications
Vector fields as gradients of scalar fields
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of two MAP45s, each weighing 30%, and a final exam weighing 40%. A resit exam, lasting 2 hours, will account for 100% of the final grade. Scores above 17 will require an oral defense. On the resit exam date, it is possible to retake one of the following: 1st MAP45, 2nd MAP45, or the 1st exam, or take the full 2-hour resit exam. Access to the resit exam or retake is subject to inscription. The special exam will be a 2-hour test, counting 100% for the final classification.
